title: Test ast.json
description: Schema for test case AST files (ast.json) in the SysProLang compiler test suite.

astNode.description: A recursive AST node. Every node has at least line, column, and kind. Other fields (value, name, op, body, elems, …) are allowed.

line.description: Line number (1-based) where the node starts in the source file.

column.description: Column number (1-based) where the node starts in the source line.

kind.description: AST node kind (e.g., Program, Declare, IntLiteral, BinOp, …).

value.description: Literal value, if any (e.g., integer literal or string).

elems.description: Ordered list of child nodes (alternative to named fields like body, left, right, etc.).
